symptom: drop + create of a flow kept every $ID and position but wrote each loop at mxcli's computed size (700;300 drawn in Studio Pro became 410;130), so loops overlapped neighbours or left their own activities outside (MPR008/MPR011 on a conversion: 2 -> 58 warnings).
cause: MDL cannot state a loop's Size, so the rebuild writes the computed one; nothing carried the stored value for the paired loop, while the plain splice keeps the stored document and so kept it.
fix: carryLoopSize in CarryUnexpressed: a Microflows$LoopedActivity paired by $ID takes max(stored, written) per dimension, so a drawn box stays and a grown body still gets room.
insight: An unstated geometry value belongs with the other unstated values in CarryUnexpressed, not in the builder: the builder has no stored document, the reconcile does. Taking the max rather than the stored value is what keeps the loop's own activities inside it when the body grew.
test: modelsdk/canon/unexpressed_loop_size_2179_test.go TestUnexpressed_LoopKeepsItsDrawnSize (controls: a computed size already larger is kept; a non-loop's size is not carried)
